description: Bundle the coach 3D model asset, add Smart Fit Tailwind color tokens, and build the coach WebGL scene component (components/coach/CoachScene.tsx). This mirrors components/chef/ChefScene.tsx but for a STATIC, UNRIGGED OBJ model, so it uses OBJLoader+MTLLoader and drives 'talking' motion by transforming the whole model group (no bones exist). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Fetch and extract the coach model in a SINGLE bash command (the sandbox /tmp does not persist across separate bash calls). Run it from inside the repo, e.g. under /projects/sandbox/frankfabric: `gh api repos/frannet82/assets/contents/coach.zip --jq .content | base64 -d > coach.zip` then use python3 zipfile to unwrap the THREE nested layers: coach.zip -> source/coach-meet-the-the-robinsons.zip -> source/Coach.zip -> Coach/ (contains Coach.obj, Coach.mtl, untitled.dae, 0000026121C8D638out.png [256x256], 0000026121C8EDF8out.png [32x32]).

Create public/models/characters/coach/ and copy in: Coach.obj (as coach.obj), Coach.mtl (as coach.mtl), and BOTH PNG textures keeping their original filenames (0000026121C8D638out.png and 0000026121C8EDF8out.png). Do NOT copy untitled.dae (Collada duplicate, unused). Delete the downloaded coach.zip and any temp extraction dirs so they are not committed.

Edit the copied public/models/characters/coach/coach.mtl: rewrite each `map_Kd` line so it references ONLY the local texture filename (e.g. `map_Kd 0000026121C8D638out.png` and `map_Kd 0000026121C8EDF8out.png`), removing the embedded Windows absolute path `C:/Users/paddync/Desktop/coach/`. Keep the two material blocks (Material.001 -> 256x256 png, Material.002 -> 32x32 png) intact otherwise.

Add Smart Fit color tokens to tailwind.config.ts under theme.extend.colors, mirroring the existing `ac` token group pattern. Add an `sf` group, e.g. sf: { yellow: '#FFF200', gold: '#FCE300', black: '#111111', ink: '#1a1a1a', magenta: '#E6007E', pink: '#ff4fb0', gray: '#2a2a2a', mist: '#f4f4f4' } (energetic bold-yellow/black with magenta accents, high contrast). Keep the existing `cloud` and `ac` groups unchanged.

Create components/coach/CoachScene.tsx as a 'use client' react-three-fiber <Canvas> component, closely following components/chef/ChefScene.tsx's structure (fixed front-facing camera, Box3-based recenter/scale, ContactShadows, ACESFilmic tone mapping, Suspense, role='img' + aria-label='3D coach avatar'). KEY DIFFERENCES because the coach OBJ is unrigged: load with MTLLoader (parse coach.mtl, set materials) + OBJLoader from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/{MTLLoader,OBJLoader}.js'; wrap both asset URLs (`asset('/models/characters/coach/coach.obj')`, `asset('/models/characters/coach/coach.mtl')`) via lib/asset.ts. Set MTLLoader resource path via asset('/models/characters/coach/') so the two PNG map_Kd files resolve; ensure loaded color maps use THREE.SRGBColorSpace. The model bounds are X[-1.437,1.437] Y[-0.0016,2.101] Z[-0.344,0.351] Y-up ~2.1 tall — recenter with a Box3 and pick a scale/aim so the coach reads as a cozy front-facing shot in an aspect-video-ish stage (analogous to ChefScene AIM constants; tune to this model's proportions).

Implement talking/idle motion WITHOUT bones: accept the same props as ChefScene ({ speaking?: boolean; getLoudness?: () => number }). In useFrame, ease a smoothed 0..1 'energy' toward 1 while speaking and 0 when idle (framerate-independent, like ChefScene's gestureRef). Multiply that energy into subtle whole-group transforms applied on TOP of the model's rest transform: a gentle vertical bob (sin), a small side-to-side sway/rotation about Y, and a slight forward lean — a few hundredths to ~0.1 rad / small unit offsets so it looks like an energetic coach talking, never flailing. When idle, add a very small always-on idle breathing bob so the figure is not perfectly static. getLoudness may be used to scale bob amplitude when >0, else fall back to the sine energy (mirror ChefScene's loudness-vs-sine fallback).
Dispose only resources this component owns on unmount (clone materials/textures if you mutate them, and dispose them), mirroring ChefScene's cleanup discipline. Do not add new npm deps.
acceptance_criteria: public/models/characters/coach/ contains coach.obj, coach.mtl (with map_Kd rewritten to local filenames), and both PNG textures; untitled.dae and the downloaded zip are NOT present/committed.
tailwind.config.ts defines a new `sf` color group (bold yellow, black, magenta accents) and leaves `cloud` and `ac` unchanged; `npm run build` compiles Tailwind with the new tokens.

components/coach/CoachScene.tsx is a 'use client' component that loads the OBJ+MTL via three/examples/jsm loaders, wraps every public/ URL in asset(), renders the coach in a fixed front-facing framing, and animates a talking/idle motion via whole-group transforms (no bone lookups, since the model is unrigged).

`npm run lint` passes and `npm run build` completes a successful static export (CoachScene is only referenced through an ssr:false dynamic import in FEAT-003, so three.js does not run during static generation).
verification: ls public/models/characters/coach/ and confirm coach.obj, coach.mtl, and the two .png textures are present and untitled.dae is absent
findings: Fetched coach.zip via `gh api repos/frannet82/assets/contents/coach.zip --jq .content | base64 -d` and unwrapped the three nested zips with python3 zipfile in ONE bash command (the /tmp non-persistence quirk was avoided by working under the repo dir). The archive layout was slightly different than described: L1 coach.zip contained source/coach-meet-the-the-robinsons.zip PLUS a duplicate textures/ folder; L2 source/coach-meet-the-the-robinsons.zip contained source/Coach.zip PLUS textures/; L3 source/Coach.zip -> Coach/ with Coach.obj, Coach.mtl, untitled.dae, and the two PNGs (0000026121C8D638out.png 256x256, 0000026121C8EDF8out.png 32x32). I extracted from the innermost Coach.zip. Committed under public/models/characters/coach/: coach.obj, coach.mtl (both map_Kd lines rewritten to bare local filenames), and both PNGs. untitled.dae was NOT copied; coach.zip and coach_extract/ were deleted before commit. Added `sf` Smart Fit color group to tailwind.config.ts (yellow/gold/black/ink/magenta/pink/gray/mist), leaving `cloud` and `ac` untouched. Created components/coach/CoachScene.tsx as a 'use client' r3f Canvas mirroring ChefScene (fixed front-facing camera, Box3 recenter+scale to ~1.6 units, ContactShadows, ACESFilmic tone mapping, Suspense, role=img/aria-label). KEY DIFFERENCE: model is unrigged OBJ, loaded with MTLLoader (setResourcePath to asset('/models/characters/coach/')) + OBJLoader from three/examples/jsm; color maps cloned and set to SRGBColorSpace; talking/idle motion applied to the whole group transform (bob + sway + Y-rotation + forward lean scaled by a smoothed 0..1 energy, with an always-on breathing bob when idle; loudness>0 scales bob amplitude, else sine fallback). Materials/maps are cloned and disposed on unmount; geometry is shared from the loader cache so not disposed. VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` passes (only the pre-existing app/layout.tsx no-page-custom-font warning, 0 errors) and `npm run build` completes a successful static export. CoachScene is NOT imported anywhere yet (that happens in FEAT-003 via ssr:false dynamic import), so it does not run during static generation. NOTE: three's OBJLoader/MTLLoader types are loose; used targeted casts (MeshPhongMaterial / { map } shape) to keep TS strict happy without adding deps.
